name: ntr_db_get_all_child_master_position_id
xsql:
--select '' position_master_position_id 
select hier.position_master_position_id from ShowIncentHierarchy(EffectiveAsOf= :v_qtr_start_date, ParentId = '79167020263211') hier 
inner join xactly.xc_pos_title_assignment pta 
on pta.position_id = hier.position_id
inner join $framework.NATERA_TITLE_CATEGORY_MAPPING t
on t.title = pta.title_name
